children: Business confidence in the Dutch manufacturing sector fell to 2.3 in October 2026 from 4.2 in September, marking its lowest reading since June.
The decline reflected weaker expectations for business activity, which fell to 16.8 from 19.4 in September, and deteriorating assessments of order books, which worsened to -4.0 from -2.3.
Meanwhile, inventory assessments deteriorated to -6.0 from -4.5.

Across sectors, sentiment weakened in food and beverages (0.3 vs 1.8), textiles, clothing and leather (-12.4 vs -2.5), paper and graphic products (-2.4 vs 3.2), and refineries and chemicals (-0.5 vs 1.1).
Confidence also eased in wood and building materials (2.3 vs 2.9) and electrical engineering and machinery (8.0 vs 11.3).
In contrast, sentiment improved in base metals and metal products (1.2 vs 3.0), transport equipment (3.8 vs 3.0), and other industry and repair (2.0 vs 1.5).

title: Dutch Manufacturing Confidence Weakens in October
